#### interface `MapEntry`

MapEntry is an entry of a map channel state or stream.

- `readonly key: string` - The entry key.
- `readonly data: unknown` - The entry data.
- `readonly tags: Record<string, string>` - The entry tags.
- `readonly offset: number` - The offset of the entry in the channel stream.
- `readonly score: number` - The sort value of the entry in ordered map channels.
- `readonly removed: boolean` - True for a removal event.
- `readonly time: number` - The time of the publication as Unix milliseconds, if known.

#### interface `MapPublishRequest`

MapPublishRequest publishes or updates a key in a map channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the map channel. Required.
- `key: string` - The entry key. Required.
- `data?: unknown` - The entry data. In the HTTP API it is any JSON value; over GRPC it may be binary.
- `b64data?: string` - Data as base64, for binary over the HTTP API. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `streamData?: unknown` - Currently not used by the server API.
- `b64streamData?: string` - Currently not used by the server API.
- `tags?: Record<string, string>` - Key-value metadata attached to the publication.
- `idempotencyKey?: string` - Drops duplicate publications upon retries: a publication with a key already used in the channel is not applied again, and its result has the first one's position, with suppressed set and `suppressReason` "idempotency". It acts per channel; keys are kept for 5 minutes by default. Every map broker - memory, Redis and PostgreSQL - keeps keys.
- `delta?: boolean` - Enables delta compression for this publication.
- `version?: number` - A per-key version: publications with a version not higher than the key's current one are suppressed.
- `versionEpoch?: string` - Scopes version. A different epoch resets version comparison.
- `score?: number` - Currently not used by the server API.
- `keyMode?: string` - Makes the publish conditional: "if_new" writes only if the key does not exist, "if_exists" only if it exists. Empty always writes.

#### interface `MapPublishResult`

MapPublishResult is the result of a map publish call.

- `readonly offset: number` - The offset in the channel stream.
- `readonly epoch: string` - The epoch of the channel stream.
- `readonly suppressed: boolean` - True if the publish was not applied, see `suppressReason`.
- `readonly suppressReason: string` - Explains why the publish was suppressed, for example "idempotency", "version", "key_exists" or "key_not_found".

#### interface `MapReadStateRequest`

MapReadStateRequest reads the current state of a map channel, with
optional pagination.

- `channel: string` - The name of the map channel. Required.
- `cursor?: string` - The pagination cursor from the previous page. Empty starts from the beginning.
- `limit?: number` - The maximum number of entries per page: -1 means no limit, 0 returns only the stream position. Page sizes may exceed it with the Redis map broker.
- `key?: string` - Reads a single entry by exact key. cursor and limit are ignored when it is set.
- `asc?: boolean` - Sorts ordered state by score ascending instead of descending. Ignored for unordered channels.
- `revisionOffset?: number` - The offset of the position from a previous state read, used with `revisionEpoch`.
- `revisionEpoch?: string` - The epoch of the position from a previous state read. If the epoch changed, the call fails with an unrecoverable position error.

#### interface `MapReadStateResult`

MapReadStateResult is the result of a map read state call.

- `readonly entries: MapEntry[]` - The state entries of this page.
- `readonly offset: number` - The offset of the channel stream position.
- `readonly epoch: string` - The epoch of the channel stream position.
- `readonly cursor: string` - The cursor of the next page. Empty if there are no more entries.

#### interface `MapReadStreamRequest`

MapReadStreamRequest reads the change stream of a map channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the map channel. Required.
- `sinceOffset?: number` - Returns entries after this offset, used with `sinceEpoch`.
- `sinceEpoch?: string` - The epoch of the since position. It must match the current stream epoch.
- `limit?: number` - The maximum number of entries: -1 means no limit, 0 returns only the stream position.
- `reverse?: boolean` - Returns entries newest first.

#### interface `MapReadStreamResult`

MapReadStreamResult is the result of a map read stream call.

- `readonly entries: MapEntry[]` - The stream entries.
- `readonly offset: number` - The top offset of the channel stream.
- `readonly epoch: string` - The epoch of the channel stream.

#### interface `MapRemoveRequest`

MapRemoveRequest removes a key from a map channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the map channel. Required.
- `key: string` - The key to remove. Required.
- `idempotencyKey?: string` - Drops duplicate removals upon retries, as it does for MapPublishRequest: a removal with a key already used in the channel is not applied again, and its result is suppressed with `suppressReason` "idempotency". Keys are kept for 5 minutes by default.

#### interface `MapRemoveResult`

MapRemoveResult is the result of a map remove call.

- `readonly offset: number` - The offset in the channel stream.
- `readonly epoch: string` - The epoch of the channel stream.
- `readonly suppressed: boolean` - True if the removal was not applied, see `suppressReason`.
- `readonly suppressReason: string` - Explains why the removal was suppressed, for example "idempotency" or "key_not_found".

#### interface `MapStatsRequest`

MapStatsRequest returns statistics about a map channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the map channel. Required.

#### interface `MapStatsResult`

MapStatsResult is the result of a map stats call.

- `readonly numKeys: number` - The number of entries in the channel state.

#### interface `Metrics`

Metrics are aggregated metrics of a node.

- `readonly interval: number` - The metrics aggregation interval in seconds.
- `readonly items: Record<string, number>` - Maps metric name to value.

#### interface `NodeResult`

NodeResult is information about a Centrifugo node.

- `readonly uid: string` - The unique ID of the node.
- `readonly name: string` - The node name.
- `readonly version: string` - The Centrifugo version of the node.
- `readonly numClients: number` - The number of clients connected to the node.
- `readonly numUsers: number` - The number of unique users connected to the node.
- `readonly numChannels: number` - The number of active channels on the node.
- `readonly uptime: number` - The node uptime in seconds.
- `readonly metrics: Metrics | undefined` - Aggregated node metrics, if available.
- `readonly process: Process | undefined` - CPU and memory usage of the node process. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `readonly numSubs: number` - The number of subscriptions on the node.

#### interface `PresenceRequest`

PresenceRequest returns the online presence of a channel: all clients
currently subscribed to it. Presence must be enabled for the channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the channel. Required.

#### interface `PresenceResult`

PresenceResult is the result of a presence call.

- `readonly presence: Record<string, ClientInfo>` - Maps client ID to information about the client.

#### interface `PresenceStatsRequest`

PresenceStatsRequest returns short presence information of a channel: the
number of clients and of unique users. Presence must be enabled for the
channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the channel. Required.

#### interface `PresenceStatsResult`

PresenceStatsResult is the result of a presence stats call.

- `readonly numClients: number` - The total number of clients in the channel.
- `readonly numUsers: number` - The number of unique users in the channel.

#### interface `Process`

Process is resource usage of a node process. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `readonly cpu: number` - The CPU usage of the process in percent.
- `readonly rss: number` - The resident set size of the process in bytes.

#### interface `Publication`

Publication is a publication in a channel history.

- `readonly data: unknown` - The publication payload.
- `readonly info: ClientInfo | undefined` - Information about the client that published, if any.
- `readonly offset: number` - The offset of the publication in the history stream.
- `readonly tags: Record<string, string>` - The publication tags.

#### interface `PublishRequest`

PublishRequest publishes data into a channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the channel to publish into. Required.
- `data?: unknown` - The payload to publish. Required unless `b64data` is set. In the HTTP API it is any JSON value; over GRPC it may be binary.
- `b64data?: string` - A base64-encoded binary payload, an alternative to `data` to send binary over the HTTP API. Centrifugo decodes it before publishing.
- `skipHistory?: boolean` - Skips adding this publication to the channel history.
- `tags?: Record<string, string>` - A map of arbitrary string keys and values attached to the publication and delivered to clients.
- `idempotencyKey?: string` - Drops duplicate publications upon retries: a publication with a key already used in the channel is not published again, and the first one's result is returned. It acts per channel; results are kept for 5 minutes by default. The memory, Redis and PostgreSQL brokers keep keys; the NATS broker ignores them.
- `delta?: boolean` - Tells Centrifugo to construct a delta update, if possible, when broadcasting the publication to subscribers.
- `version?: number` - When > 0, the version of the document being sent: publications with a version less than or equal to one already seen are ignored. Only works in channels with history enabled.
- `versionEpoch?: string` - The epoch of version. When it changes, Centrifugo accepts the publication even if its version is lower than before.

#### interface `PublishResult`

PublishResult is the result of a successful publish.

- `readonly offset: number` - The offset of the publication in the channel history stream.
- `readonly epoch: string` - The epoch of the channel history stream.

#### interface `PushLimitStrategy`

PushLimitStrategy limits when and how often pushes are sent.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `rateLimit?: PushRateLimitStrategy` - Sets rate limit policies.
- `timeLimit?: PushTimeLimitStrategy` - Sets a time limit policy based on the device timezone.

#### interface `PushLocalization`

PushLocalization holds translations for one language/locale.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `translations?: Record<string, string>` - Maps variable name to value for the language/locale.

#### interface `PushNotification`

PushNotification is a push notification in the format of each provider.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `fcm?: FcmPushNotification` - The notification for FCM.
- `hms?: HmsPushNotification` - The notification for HMS.
- `apns?: ApnsPushNotification` - The notification for APNs.
- `webpush?: WebPushPushNotification` - The notification for Web Push.
- `expireAt?: number` - The Unix time in seconds when Centrifugo stops trying to send the notification. Not related to the providers' TTL fields.

#### interface `PushRateLimitStrategy`

PushRateLimitStrategy rate limits pushes per device. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `key?: string` - An optional key for the rate limit policy. Supports variables (device.id and device.user).
- `policies?: readonly RateLimitPolicy[]` - The rate limit policies to apply.
- `dropIfRateLimited?: boolean` - Drops a rate limited push instead of queuing it for later.

#### interface `PushRecipient`

PushRecipient describes who receives a push notification. Set only one
of its fields. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `filter?: DeviceFilter` - Sends to devices from Centrifugo device storage that match the filter.
- `fcmTokens?: readonly string[]` - Sends to a list of FCM native tokens.
- `fcmTopic?: string` - Sends to an FCM native topic.
- `fcmCondition?: string` - Sends to an FCM native condition.
- `hmsTokens?: readonly string[]` - Sends to a list of HMS native tokens.
- `hmsTopic?: string` - Sends to an HMS native topic.
- `hmsCondition?: string` - Sends to an HMS native condition.
- `apnsTokens?: readonly string[]` - Sends to a list of APNs native tokens.
- `webpushTokens?: readonly string[]` - Sends to a list of raw Web Push subscriptions, each a PushSubscription JSON string.

#### interface `PushTimeLimitStrategy`

PushTimeLimitStrategy sends pushes within a window of the device local
time. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `sendAfterTime: string` - The local time, as HH:MM:SS, after which the push may be sent. Required.
- `sendBeforeTime: string` - The local time, as HH:MM:SS, before which the push must be sent. Required.
- `noTzSendNow?: boolean` - Sends the push immediately if the device timezone is not set. By default such pushes are dropped.

#### interface `RateLimitPolicy`

RateLimitPolicy allows rate pushes per `intervalMs`. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `rate: number` - The allowed number of pushes per interval. Required.
- `intervalMs: number` - The interval in milliseconds. Required.

#### interface `RefreshRequest`

RefreshRequest refreshes a user's connections, mostly useful with
unidirectional transports. Without `expireAt` the connections become
non-expiring.

- `user?: string` - The ID of the user to refresh. Required, unless `allUsers` is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `client?: string` - Limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `expired?: boolean` - Marks the connections as expired and closes them with an expired disconnect reason.
- `expireAt?: number` - The Unix time in seconds when the connections expire.
- `info?: unknown` - Attaches or replaces the connection info.
- `session?: string` - Limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `labelFilter?: FilterNode` - Restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `allUsers?: boolean` - Works as SubscribeRequest.allUsers. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### type `RefreshResult`

```ts
type RefreshResult = Record<string, never>;
```

RefreshResult is the result of a refresh call. Empty at the moment.

#### interface `RevokeTokenRequest`

RevokeTokenRequest revokes a token by its unique ID (jti claim of a JWT).
Clients using the token are disconnected shortly, and can not connect
with it again. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `expireAt?: number` - The Unix time in seconds when the revocation expires. Optional, but a value matching the token expiration is recommended.
- `uid: string` - The unique ID of the token to revoke (jti claim). Required.

#### type `RevokeTokenResult`

```ts
type RevokeTokenResult = Record<string, never>;
```

RevokeTokenResult is the result of a revoke token call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### interface `SendPushNotificationRequest`

SendPushNotificationRequest sends a push notification. The request is
queued and sent to the provider by Centrifugo workers.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `recipient: PushRecipient` - Who receives the notification. Required.
- `notification: PushNotification` - The notification to send. Required.
- `uid?: string` - A unique identifier of the request, can be used to cancel the push. UUID v4 is recommended; different requests must use different uids.
- `sendAt?: number` - The Unix time in seconds when to send the notification. If not set, the notification is sent immediately.
- `optimizeForReliability?: boolean` - Makes processing heavier, but tolerates edge cases, like not losing inflight pushes when the queue is briefly unavailable.
- `limitStrategy?: PushLimitStrategy` - Sets time constraints and rate limits. Only applies with a filter recipient; devices are then processed one by one instead of in batches.
- `analyticsUid?: string` - The identifier for push notification analytics. If not set, uid is used.
- `localizations?: Record<string, PushLocalization>` - Optional per language/locale localizations. Setting them enables templating.
- `useTemplating?: boolean` - Enables templating of the notification. Only works with a filter recipient.
- `useMeta?: boolean` - Additionally loads device meta while sending, making it available in templating.

#### interface `SendPushNotificationResult`

SendPushNotificationResult is the result of a send push notification
call. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `readonly uid: string` - The unique identifier of the send request (not a provider message ID). Matches the request uid if it was set.

#### interface `SharedPollPublishRequest`

SharedPollPublishRequest pushes data for a key directly to clients of a
shared poll channel, without waiting for the next poll cycle. Requires
versioned mode and publish_enabled on the namespace.

- `channel: string` - The name of the shared poll channel. Required.
- `key: string` - The item key. Required.
- `data?: unknown` - The item data, delivered to clients as is.
- `b64data?: string` - Data as base64, for binary payloads. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `version: number` - The item version, must be >= 1. Required. A version not higher than the current one within the same epoch is silently dropped.
- `epoch?: string` - The channel-level publisher epoch. A change resets per-key versions and unsubscribes current subscribers with insufficient state.

#### type `SharedPollPublishResult`

```ts
type SharedPollPublishResult = Record<string, never>;
```

SharedPollPublishResult is the result of a shared poll publish call.
Empty at the moment.

#### interface `StreamPosition`

StreamPosition is a position in a channel stream.

- `offset?: number` - The offset in the stream.
- `epoch?: string` - The stream epoch.

#### interface `SubscribeOptionOverride`

SubscribeOptionOverride overrides channel options for a server-side
subscription. Unset fields keep the value from the channel configuration.

- `presence?: boolean` - Overrides the presence channel option.
- `joinLeave?: boolean` - Overrides the `joinLeave` channel option.
- `forceRecovery?: boolean` - Overrides the `forceRecovery` channel option.
- `forcePositioning?: boolean` - Overrides the `forcePositioning` channel option.
- `forcePushJoinLeave?: boolean` - Overrides the `forcePushJoinLeave` channel option.

#### interface `SubscribeRequest`

SubscribeRequest subscribes active sessions of a user to a channel
(server-side subscription). It does not create a streaming subscription
for the caller.

- `channel: string` - The name of the channel to subscribe to. Required.
- `user?: string` - The ID of the user to subscribe. Required, unless `allUsers` is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `expireAt?: number` - The Unix time in seconds when the subscription expires.
- `info?: unknown` - Custom channel info attached to the subscription, used in presence and join/leave messages.
- `b64info?: string` - Info as base64, for binary. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `client?: string` - Limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `data?: unknown` - Custom subscription data sent to the client in the Subscribe push.
- `b64data?: string` - Data as base64, for binary. Centrifugo decodes it.
- `recoverSince?: StreamPosition` - The stream position to recover publications from.
- `override?: SubscribeOptionOverride` - Dynamically overrides some channel options set in the Centrifugo configuration.
- `session?: string` - Limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `labelFilter?: FilterNode` - Restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `allUsers?: boolean` - When user is empty, targets every connection on every node instead of the anonymous-only bucket. No effect when user is non-empty. Without `labelFilter` it acts on every connection. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### type `SubscribeResult`

```ts
type SubscribeResult = Record<string, never>;
```

SubscribeResult is the result of a subscribe call. Empty at the moment.

#### interface `SubscriptionTokenInfo`

SubscriptionTokenInfo is information about a subscription token.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `readonly uid: string` - The unique token ID (jti claim).
- `readonly issuedAt: number` - The Unix time in seconds when the token was issued.

#### interface `UnblockUserRequest`

UnblockUserRequest unblocks a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: string` - The ID of the user to unblock. Required.

#### type `UnblockUserResult`

```ts
type UnblockUserResult = Record<string, never>;
```

UnblockUserResult is the result of an unblock user call. Empty at the
moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### interface `UnsubscribeRequest`

UnsubscribeRequest unsubscribes a user from a channel.

- `channel: string` - The name of the channel to unsubscribe from. Required.
- `user?: string` - The ID of the user to unsubscribe. Required, unless `allUsers` is used in Centrifugo PRO.
- `client?: string` - Limits the call to the connection with this client ID. user is still required.
- `session?: string` - Limits the call to the connection with this session ID. user is still required.
- `labelFilter?: FilterNode` - Restricts the call to clients whose labels match this filter. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `allUsers?: boolean` - Works as SubscribeRequest.allUsers. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### type `UnsubscribeResult`

```ts
type UnsubscribeResult = Record<string, never>;
```

UnsubscribeResult is the result of an unsubscribe call. Empty at the
moment.

#### interface `UpdatePushStatusRequest`

UpdatePushStatusRequest saves the delivery or interaction status of a
push notification to analytics. Experimental. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `analyticsUid: string` - The `analyticsUid` of the push notification (as in SendPushNotificationRequest). Required.
- `status: string` - The status of the push notification: delivered or interacted. Required.
- `deviceId: string` - The Centrifugo device ID. Required.
- `msgId?: string` - The message ID issued by the provider.

#### type `UpdatePushStatusResult`

```ts
type UpdatePushStatusResult = Record<string, never>;
```

UpdatePushStatusResult is the result of an update push status call.
Empty at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### interface `UpdateUserStatusRequest`

UpdateUserStatusRequest marks users as active and online now, and sets
their state when one is given. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `users: readonly string[]` - The list of user IDs to update the status for. Required.
- `state?: string` - An optional custom state to store in the user status. It can be restricted by the user_status.state_regex option.

#### type `UpdateUserStatusResult`

```ts
type UpdateUserStatusResult = Record<string, never>;
```

UpdateUserStatusResult is the result of an update user status call. Empty
at the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### interface `UserStatus`

UserStatus is the status of a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `readonly user: string` - The user ID.
- `readonly active: number` - The last active time as Unix seconds. Not set if unknown.
- `readonly online: number` - The last online time as Unix seconds, updated by Centrifugo while the user is connected. Not set if unknown.
- `readonly state: string` - The custom state set with UpdateUserStatusRequest.state, if any.

#### interface `UserTopic`

UserTopic is a topic subscription of a user. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `readonly id: string` - The ID of the user topic.
- `readonly user: string` - The user ID.
- `readonly topic: string` - The topic.

#### interface `UserTopicFilter`

UserTopicFilter selects user topic subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `users?: readonly string[]` - Selects by user.
- `topics?: readonly string[]` - Selects by topic.
- `topicPrefix?: string` - Selects by topic prefix.

#### interface `UserTopicListRequest`

UserTopicListRequest returns a paginated list of user topic
subscriptions. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `filter?: UserTopicFilter` - Selects the user topics to list.
- `includeTotalCount?: boolean` - Includes the total count for the filter in the result.
- `cursor?: string` - The pagination cursor: `nextCursor` of the previous page, empty for the first page.
- `limit?: number` - The maximum number of items to return.

#### interface `UserTopicListResult`

UserTopicListResult is the result of a user topic list call.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `readonly items: UserTopic[]` - The user topics of this page.
- `readonly nextCursor: string` - The cursor of the next page. Empty if there is no next page.
- `readonly totalCount: number` - The total count for the filter, if `includeTotalCount` was set.

#### interface `UserTopicUpdateRequest`

UserTopicUpdateRequest changes the topics of a user. The change is also
applied to the user's registered devices. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `user: string` - The user ID. Required. "" updates the global binding, which every device - anonymous ones included - gets on its next `deviceRegister`.
- `op: string` - The operation: add, remove or set. Required.
- `topics?: readonly string[]` - The topics for the operation.

#### type `UserTopicUpdateResult`

```ts
type UserTopicUpdateResult = Record<string, never>;
```

UserTopicUpdateResult is the result of a user topic update call. Empty at
the moment. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### interface `WebPushPushNotification`

WebPushPushNotification is a notification for Web Push.
Centrifugo PRO only.

- `headers?: Record<string, string>` - Web Push HTTP headers. Recognized keys: TTL (seconds, default 4 weeks), Urgency (very-low, low, normal, high) and Topic.
- `payload: unknown` - The JSON payload delivered to the browser service worker. Required.

## jscent/proxy: request and result types

<details>
<summary>29 types</summary>

#### interface `ChannelEvent`

ChannelEvent is a change of a channel's state.

- `readonly timeMs: number` - When it happened, in Unix milliseconds.
- `readonly channel: string` - The channel it happened in.
- `readonly type: string` - "occupied" when the channel got its first subscriber, "vacated" when it lost its last one. More types may come; the field is a string, not an enum, for JSON interoperability.

#### interface `ChannelsCapability`

ChannelsCapability grants operations in channels. A connection may do an
operation in a channel when any of its capabilities both allows the
operation and matches the channel. Centrifugo PRO only.

- `channels?: readonly string[]` - The channels, or channel patterns, it applies to.
- `allow?: readonly string[]` - The operations it grants: "sub" (subscribe), "pub" (publish), "hst" (history) and "prs" (presence).
- `match?: string` - How channels are matched: empty for exact names, "wildcard" or "regex".

#### interface `ConnectRequest`

ConnectRequest is sent when a client connects.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport: "websocket", "sse", "uni_sse" and the like.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly data: unknown` - The custom data the client sent with its connect command, if any.
- `readonly b64data: string` - Data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `readonly name: string` - The client's name, if it sent one.
- `readonly version: string` - The client's version, if it sent one.
- `readonly channels: string[]` - The server-side channels the client asks to be subscribed to. The backend checks its permissions and returns the allowed ones in ConnectResult.channels or ConnectResult.subs.

#### interface `ConnectResult`

ConnectResult accepts the connection.

- `user?: string` - The ID of the user the connection belongs to. Empty accepts an anonymous connection.
- `expireAt?: number` - When the connection expires, in Unix seconds, unless refreshed - by the refresh proxy, when one is configured. Zero means it does not expire.
- `info?: unknown` - Information about the connection, as JSON: it is part of presence data, join and leave events and the client's publications.
- `b64info?: string` - Info in base64, for binary info.
- `data?: unknown` - Custom data sent to the client in the connect reply.
- `b64data?: string` - Data in base64, for binary data.
- `channels?: readonly string[]` - Server-side channels to subscribe the connection to.
- `subs?: Record<string, SubscribeOptions>` - Server-side channels to subscribe the connection to, each with its options.
- `meta?: unknown` - Custom data attached to the connection, as JSON. It is never sent to the client; proxies with include_connection_meta receive it.
- `caps?: readonly ChannelsCapability[]` - Capabilities granting the connection operations in channels. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `labels?: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — client labels attached to the centrifuge.Client by Centrifugo PRO. Parsed by OSS but not used (OSS does not populate centrifuge.ConnectReply.Labels).

#### interface `FilterNode`

FilterNode is a node of a publication tags filter expression. A leaf node
compares one tag: it sets key, cmp and val or vals, and leaves op empty. A
logical node combines its nodes: it sets op and nodes only.

- `op?: string` - The logical operation: "and", "or" or "not". Empty for a leaf node.
- `key?: string` - The tag a leaf node compares.
- `cmp?: string` - The comparison of a leaf node: "eq", "neq", "in", "nin", "ex" (exists), "nex" (does not exist), "sw" (starts with), "ew" (ends with), "ct" (contains), "gt", "gte", "lt" or "lte".
- `val?: string` - The value most comparisons compare the tag with.
- `vals?: readonly string[]` - The values "in" and "nin" compare the tag with.
- `nodes?: readonly FilterNode[]` - The operands of a logical node.

#### interface `MapPublishRequest`

MapPublishRequest is sent when a client publishes a key into a map channel.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly channel: string` - The map channel the client publishes into.
- `readonly key: string` - The key the client publishes, empty if it sent none.
- `readonly data: unknown` - The data the client publishes.
- `readonly b64data: string` - Data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `MapPublishResult`

MapPublishResult accepts the publication, even when empty. Fields left
unset keep what the client sent, or the defaults.

- `key?: string` - Replaces the key the client sent: to force a key the server derives, such as the user ID.
- `data?: unknown` - Replaces the data the client sent.
- `b64data?: string` - Data in base64, for binary data.
- `tags?: Record<string, string>` - Attached to the publication: clients cannot send tags, so this is where server-side tag filters get their tags from.
- `score?: number` - Not used by Centrifugo yet.
- `keyMode?: string` - Makes the publication conditional: "if_new" publishes only a key which does not exist yet, "if_exists" only one which does.
- `streamData?: unknown` - Not used by Centrifugo yet.
- `b64streamData?: string` - Not used by Centrifugo yet.
- `idempotencyKey?: string` - Makes the publication idempotent: another one with the same key within the broker's idempotency window is not published.
- `delta?: boolean` - Enables delta compression for the publication.
- `version?: number` - The key's version: Centrifugo drops a publication older than the key's latest.
- `versionEpoch?: string` - Scopes version, for versions which may start over.

#### interface `MapRemoveRequest`

MapRemoveRequest is sent when a client removes a key from a map channel.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly channel: string` - The map channel the client removes the key from.
- `readonly key: string` - The key the client removes.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `MapRemoveResult`

MapRemoveResult accepts the removal, even when empty. Fields left unset
keep what the client sent, or the defaults.

- `key?: string` - Replaces the key the client sent.
- `tags?: Record<string, string>` - Attached to the removal publication. When unset, the removed entry's own tags are.
- `idempotencyKey?: string` - Makes the removal idempotent within the broker's idempotency window.

#### interface `NotifyCacheEmptyRequest`

NotifyCacheEmptyRequest is sent when a client subscribed to a channel in
cache recovery mode which has no publication to recover from. Centrifugo
PRO only.

- `readonly channel: string` - The channel whose cache is empty.

#### interface `NotifyCacheEmptyResult`

NotifyCacheEmptyResult is the NotifyCacheEmptyResult message of the Centrifugo proxy protocol.

- `populated?: boolean` - Tells Centrifugo that the backend published into the channel, so that it tries to recover the state once more.

#### interface `NotifyChannelStateRequest`

NotifyChannelStateRequest carries channel state events. Centrifugo PRO
only, in preview.

- `readonly events: ChannelEvent[]` - The events which happened, in channels with presence.

#### type `NotifyChannelStateResult`

```ts
type NotifyChannelStateResult = Record<string, never>;
```

NotifyChannelStateResult is the NotifyChannelStateResult message of the Centrifugo proxy protocol.

#### interface `PublishRequest`

PublishRequest is sent when a client publishes into a channel.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly channel: string` - The channel the client publishes into.
- `readonly data: unknown` - The data the client publishes.
- `readonly b64data: string` - Data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `PublishResult`

PublishResult accepts the publication. Fields left unset keep what the
client sent, or the defaults.

- `data?: unknown` - Replaces the data the client sent.
- `b64data?: string` - Data in base64, for binary data.
- `skipHistory?: boolean` - Publishes without saving the publication to the channel's history. Not allowed in channels with delta compression.
- `tags?: Record<string, string>` - Attached to the publication: clients cannot send tags, so this is where server-side tag filters get their tags from.
- `idempotencyKey?: string` - Makes the publication idempotent: another one with the same key in the channel within the broker's idempotency window is not published.
- `delta?: boolean` - Enables delta compression for the publication.
- `version?: number` - The publication's version, for channels whose publications each carry the whole state: Centrifugo drops one older than the latest.
- `versionEpoch?: string` - Scopes version, for versions which may start over - when they come from a system which can lose its state, say.

#### interface `RefreshRequest`

RefreshRequest is sent when a connection is about to expire.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `RefreshResult`

RefreshResult extends the connection, or ends it.

- `expired?: boolean` - Disconnects the client: its connection has expired.
- `expireAt?: number` - When the connection expires next, in Unix seconds.
- `info?: unknown` - Replaces the connection's info, as JSON.
- `b64info?: string` - Info in base64, for binary info.
- `meta?: unknown` - Replaces the connection's meta, as JSON.
- `caps?: readonly ChannelsCapability[]` - Replace the connection's capabilities. Centrifugo PRO only.

#### interface `RPCRequest`

RPCRequest is sent when a client makes an RPC call.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly method: string` - The method the client calls, empty if it named none.
- `readonly data: unknown` - The data the client sent with the call.
- `readonly b64data: string` - Data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `RPCResult`

RPCResult is the call's result.

- `data?: unknown` - The result sent to the client: any JSON.
- `b64data?: string` - Data in base64, for binary data.

#### interface `SharedPollRefreshItem`

SharedPollRefreshItem is an item to refresh.

- `readonly key: string` - The item's key.
- `readonly version: number` - The latest version of the item Centrifugo has, in versioned mode: zero when it has none. Not set in versionless mode.

#### interface `SharedPollRefreshRequest`

SharedPollRefreshRequest asks for the current data of items tracked in a
shared poll channel.

- `readonly channel: string` - The shared poll channel.
- `readonly items: SharedPollRefreshItem[]` - The tracked items to refresh.

#### interface `SharedPollRefreshResult`

SharedPollRefreshResult carries the items' current data. An item left out
is unchanged.

- `items?: readonly SharedPollRefreshResultItem[]` - The items' current data.
- `epoch?: string` - Identifies the publisher's version space: when it differs from the channel's, Centrifugo drops the versions and data it keeps and resubscribes the channel's subscribers. Generate one per process start, and send the same one with direct publishes. Empty means versions are never reset.

#### interface `SharedPollRefreshResultItem`

SharedPollRefreshResultItem is an item's current data.

- `key?: string` - The item's key.
- `data?: unknown` - The item's data. In versioned mode it may be left out for an item which has not changed.
- `version?: number` - The item's version: required in versioned mode, optional in versionless mode. It must grow when the item changes.
- `removed?: boolean` - Removes the item: subscribers are told so, and it is no longer tracked.
- `prevData?: unknown` - The item's previous data, the base for delta compression when the namespace uses it, so that Centrifugo need not keep it.

#### interface `SubRefreshRequest`

SubRefreshRequest is sent when a subscription is about to expire.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly channel: string` - The channel whose subscription is about to expire.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `SubRefreshResult`

SubRefreshResult extends the subscription, or ends it.

- `expired?: boolean` - Ends the subscription: it has expired.
- `expireAt?: number` - When the subscription expires next, in Unix seconds.
- `info?: unknown` - Replaces the channel-specific information about the connection, as JSON.
- `b64info?: string` - Info in base64, for binary info.
- `serverTagsFilter?: FilterNode` - When set, replaces the server-side tags filter of the subscription (Centrifugo PRO). When not set the filter is kept as it is.

#### interface `SubscribeOptionOverride`

SubscribeOptionOverride overrides channel options of the namespace for one
subscription. An unset field keeps the namespace's value.

- `presence?: boolean` - Overrides the namespace's presence option.
- `joinLeave?: boolean` - Overrides the namespace's `joinLeave` option.
- `forceRecovery?: boolean` - Overrides the namespace's `forceRecovery` option.
- `forcePositioning?: boolean` - Overrides the namespace's `forcePositioning` option.
- `forcePushJoinLeave?: boolean` - Overrides the namespace's `forcePushJoinLeave` option.

#### interface `SubscribeOptions`

SubscribeOptions are the options of a server-side subscription returned in
ConnectResult.subs.

- `expireAt?: number` - When the subscription expires, in Unix seconds. Zero means it does not expire.
- `info?: unknown` - Channel-specific information about the connection, as JSON: it is part of presence data, join and leave events and the client's publications in the channel.
- `b64info?: string` - Info in base64, for binary info.
- `data?: unknown` - Custom data sent to the client with the subscription in the connect reply.
- `b64data?: string` - Data in base64, for binary data.
- `override?: SubscribeOptionOverride` - Overrides channel options of the namespace for this subscription.
- `serverTagsFilter?: FilterNode` - Makes the subscription receive only publications whose tags match it. Centrifugo PRO only.
- `cacheRecover?: boolean` - When set, makes Centrifugo initiate cache recovery for the server-side subscription without requiring the client to provide a recover flag/position itself. This is the server-side equivalent of subscribing with an empty `since` on the client. Mostly useful for unidirectional clients which do not know channel names. Requires recovery to be enabled for the channel and only applies in cache recovery mode, where it delivers the latest publication on (re)subscribe.

#### interface `SubscribeRequest`

SubscribeRequest is sent when a client subscribes to a channel.

- `readonly client: string` - The unique ID Centrifugo gave the connection.
- `readonly transport: string` - The connection's transport.
- `readonly protocol: string` - The client protocol: "json" or "protobuf".
- `readonly encoding: string` - "binary" when the proxy has binary_encoding enabled, so that payloads come in the b64 fields, and "json" otherwise.
- `readonly user: string` - The connection's user ID.
- `readonly channel: string` - The channel the client subscribes to.
- `readonly token: string` - The subscription token the client sent for the channel, if any.
- `readonly meta: unknown` - The connection's meta, when the proxy has include_connection_meta.
- `readonly data: unknown` - The custom data the client sent with its subscribe command, if any.
- `readonly b64data: string` - Data in base64, sent instead of data in binary encoding mode.
- `readonly labels: Record<string, string>` - PRO only — connection labels attached to the originating centrifuge.Client. Centrifugo PRO always populates this from Client.Labels() (no opt-in toggle).

#### interface `SubscribeResult`

SubscribeResult accepts the subscription.

- `expireAt?: number` - When the subscription expires, in Unix seconds, unless refreshed - by the sub refresh proxy, when one is configured. Zero means it does not expire.
- `info?: unknown` - Channel-specific information about the connection, as JSON: it is part of presence data, join and leave events and the client's publications in the channel.
- `b64info?: string` - Info in base64, for binary info.
- `data?: unknown` - Custom data sent to the client in the subscribe reply.
- `b64data?: string` - Data in base64, for binary data.
- `override?: SubscribeOptionOverride` - Overrides channel options of the namespace for this subscription.
- `allow?: readonly string[]` - Capabilities granted in the channel for this subscription: "sub", "pub", "hst" and "prs". Centrifugo PRO only.
- `serverTagsFilter?: FilterNode` - Makes the subscription receive only publications whose tags match it. Centrifugo PRO only.

</details>
